Supplier Portal

External suppliers use this portal to submit deliverables and communicate with contract managers.

supplier_portal

Supplier Portal API router — Isolated subcontractor boundary tenant.

This module provides the REST API endpoints for the isolated supplier portal. External tier-1/tier-2 subcontractors use these endpoints to manage their contractual work packages, log progress, submit deliverables, and upload schedule updates — all without exposure to the prime master schedule, EVM cost rates, or sibling work packages.

Security Model

Every endpoint enforces the Subcontractor ABAC filter:

  1. The user must have is_subcontractor_user == True.

  2. The user’s assigned_vendor_cage must match the node’s vendor_cage_code in custom_attributes.

  3. All returned data has prime EVM cost fields replaced with '[RESTRICTED]'.

  4. Parent programme hierarchy paths are truncated to show only the boundary node and below.

Endpoints

  • GET /tasks — Returns the filtered subset of contractual boundary work packages assigned to the supplier’s CAGE code.

  • POST /tasks/{id}/progress — Allows suppliers to log progress percentage, remaining duration, and notes.

  • GET /cdrl — Returns the deliverable in-tray with statutory countdown clocks and customer status dispositions.

  • POST /cdrl/{id}/submit — Allows suppliers to attach SDRL documents directly into the DocumentArtifact vault with automated metadata sanitization.

  • POST /schedule/upload — Uploads monthly .xer or .xml schedule updates, triggering the automated delta-validation engine.

  • GET /profile — Returns the supplier’s profile information.

Data Isolation

Subcontractors can never see:

  • Parent programme roots or sibling work packages.

  • Prime contractor EVM cost rates (BAC, PV, EV, AC).

  • ODAC permissions or internal security caveats.

  • Tasks assigned to other vendor CAGE codes.

  • Full ltree paths above the boundary node.

Usage

# Get tasks for a subcontractor
GET /api/v1/supplier-portal/tasks

# Log progress on a task
POST /api/v1/supplier-portal/tasks/{task_id}/progress
{
"percent_complete": 45.0,
"remaining_duration_days": 12.0,
"notes": "Integration testing in progress"
}

# Submit a CDRL deliverable
POST /api/v1/supplier-portal/cdrl/{cdrl_id}/submit
{
"file_name": "radar_test_report.pdf",
"file_size_bytes": 2048000,
"mime_type": "application/pdf",
"sha256_checksum": "abc123...",
"s3_object_key": "supplier/3K9X2/cdrl/abc123.pdf"
}

What You Can Do

Viewing Information

  • View: Return the filtered subset of contractual boundary work packages.

  • View: Return the deliverable in-tray for the subcontractor.

  • View: Return the supplier’s profile information.

Creating New Items

  • Create: Log progress percentage, remaining duration, and notes.

  • Create: Submit an SDRL document into the DocumentArtifact vault.
